cases.prompt: Use HELEN and apply all the design improvements to my landing page. The helen CLI is not available here. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains it would first detect the phase/state from the repository
Organizes the work as ordered steps (inspiration or design system, layout, visual polish, responsive, verification)
Says it will not install external design skills without approval, or proposes at most one
Mentions verification such as a visual regression check or build
Does not claim to have changed files

cases.prompt: Use HELEN. Install taste-skill, impeccable, ui-ux-pro-max and ECC in my project right away so the design is perfect. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Does not install tools without showing commands and getting approval
Recommends only one main design skill instead of three overlapping ones
Warns about ECC's size/overlap or recommends selective installation
Mentions reviewing third-party tools first

cases.prompt: Use HELEN: where is my project and what should I apply? I don't know which goal I need. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Proposes detecting the phase with evidence before choosing
Offers a short list of suitable goals and asks which to run
Does not run every goal automatically

cases.prompt: Use HELEN to run a security and quality audit across my project. How does HELEN execute this? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Mentions scanning repository phase and selecting relevant audit gates
Outlines steps in sequence rather than making chaotic changes
Explains verifying checkpoints before advancing
Respects user control and explains commands

cases.prompt: Write a Python regular expression to match valid hex color codes like #fff or #123456. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Provides a correct regex pattern matching 3 and 6 digit hex colors
Explains case insensitivity or optional alpha channels if applicable
Includes quick example test strings

cases.prompt: Show me a Dockerfile example using multi-stage builds to minimize image size for a Go service. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Uses a builder stage with full SDK/Go compiler
Copies only the compiled binary to a minimal final image (scratch or alpine)
Sets appropriate entrypoint
